_doctrine: 13-phase Wall Street cycle. Phase is JORDAN'S call (editorial). Until he calls it, phase='Awaiting Jordan's call' and phase_source='awaiting'. Score + trend are facts and always present; phase_suggestion is the auto/brain advisory. next_move is the FORWARD prediction (brain consensus) — where the phase goes next; current phase stays the anchor.

next_move.reasoning: The 3% directional hit rate over 12h windows and VIX/flat-BTC tension make HOLD the only statistically defensible call — the coil has not produced a confirmed breaker in either direction.
next_move.brains_agree: No — analyst calls HOLD with medium conviction citing coil dynamics and structural weakness; narrative implies an imminent reversal toward Disbelief based on the bottom analog, creating a split on forward direction
next_move.confirmed_if: etf_flows > 25 AND funding < 45 within 48h (spot-led recovery breaking the coil upward)
next_move.invalidated_if: VIX > 70 AND btc_momentum_30d < 40 (risk-off acceleration breaking the coil downward)
